title.narrative: To improve education access, 842,321 out-of-school children (51% girls, 480 children with disabilities) were enrolled in school. UNICEF supported government to improve the quality of early learning for 6.4 million children, by training 197,266 frontline workers on play-based learning using blended approaches, and in counselling parents on supporting play in the home at 250,434 ECD centres and schools. To implement India’s policy on foundational literacy and numeracy, UNICEF trained 93,319 teachers and supervisors (40% female) on teaching reading, benefitting 2.1 million children.
